why: build step for the memory restart in next/ (docs/plan/lanes/memory-restart-PLAN.md): L1 to L9 are green on the build, at the default depth and at FABRIKA_TEST_DEPTH=full, with every listed settings and driver file green, lint, the ratchet and the leak grep clean. Not done for two reasons outside the product: pnpm typecheck is red with 30 errors, all in two test files the tests step wrote and never typechecked (dev.laws.integration.test.ts and dev-control.laws.integration.test.ts call start on Context.get(local, ControlPlugin), which Alchemy's plugin contract types as a union with no start, plus a WorkerdExit and helper R types); and L10 and L11, host-only laws on real workerd, were not started, as 0178 says a step never starts one on the owner's Mac.
note: Ruling 1 is built as two call entry points in dev.ts: call (a binding's call, which waits for a pending replacement's listener for at most the grace plus 30 s) and callNow (the outbox flush and the span recording, which never wait and fail as offline at once). At full depth dev-control's call law first failed: a call right after an exit still dialed, because the exit's row was written before the exit was folded, and the runtime's callback only queues an event. The build folds the exit before its row and makes call yield once before it reads the state; that yield leans on Effect's scheduler running the woken event fiber first, so a sync fold in the callback is the stronger fix. --changed origin/main also showed two failures that are the same on main's product files: jobs-wire.integration.test.ts A14 (unreachable on jobs.take) and watch.laws.integration.test.ts L17/L18 (its three fast runs never reach the compiler move). The generated person.json gives desktop.brain-memory the pattern of a digit string, so an editor refuses the documented "500 MB".
